title: AWS Cost
description: AWS cost visibility via Data Exports (CUR 2.0) + Athena. Consolidated billing across all accounts.

panels.description: Total unblended cost for the selected billing period, excluding taxes. Action: If exceeding budget, check Daily Spend by Service for the largest contributor.
panels.title: Total Monthly Spend

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS total_cost
FROM cost_and_usage
WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
  AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
  AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR product_product_name = '$service')

panels.description: Projected end-of-month cost based on average daily spend extrapolated to the full month. Action: If the estimate exceeds your budget, investigate top services and consider scaling down or rightsizing.
panels.title: Estimated End-of-Month

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT (SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) / COUNT(DISTINCT date_parse(split_part(identity_time_interval, '/', 1), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ')))
  * DAY(LAST_DAY_OF_MONTH(DATE(MAX(billing_period) || '-01'))) AS estimated_eom
FROM cost_and_usage
WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
  AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
  AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR product_product_name = '$service')

panels.description: Percentage change in total spend compared to the prior billing period. Action: If growth exceeds 20%, investigate new resources or usage spikes in the Daily Spend Trend.
panels.title: Month-over-Month Change

targets.rawSQL:
WITH selected AS (
  SELECT SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost
  FROM cost_and_usage
  WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
    AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
    AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
    AND ('$service' = 'All' OR product_product_name = '$service')
),
prior AS (
  SELECT SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost
  FROM cost_and_usage
  WHERE billing_period = (
      SELECT MAX(billing_period) FROM cost_and_usage
      WHERE billing_period < '$billing_period'
    )
    AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
    AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
    AND ('$service' = 'All' OR product_product_name = '$service')
)
SELECT CASE
    WHEN (SELECT cost FROM prior) IS NULL OR (SELECT cost FROM prior) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE 100.0 * ((SELECT cost FROM selected) - (SELECT cost FROM prior)) / (SELECT cost FROM prior)
  END AS pct_change

panels.description: Cost distribution across AWS accounts for the selected billing period. Action: If one account dominates unexpectedly, filter by that account to drill into service-level costs.
panels.title: Spend by Account

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT line_item_usage_account_id AS account,
  SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost
FROM cost_and_usage
WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
  AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
  AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR product_product_name = '$service')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: Percentage of monthly budget consumed so far. Set your target budget using the Budget dropdown. Action: If above 80% before mid-month, review top services and consider deferring non-critical workloads.
panels.title: Budget vs Actual

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) / CAST('$budget' AS DOUBLE) AS budget_pct
FROM cost_and_usage
WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
  AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
  AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR product_product_name = '$service')

panels.description: Dollar split between on-demand usage and Savings Plan covered usage. Action: If on-demand dominates, evaluate purchasing Savings Plans for consistently used services to reduce costs by up to 30%.
panels.title: On-Demand vs SP Covered

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT CASE line_item_line_item_type
    WHEN 'Usage' THEN 'On-Demand'
    WHEN 'SavingsPlanCoveredUsage' THEN 'SP Covered'
  END AS category,
  SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost
FROM cost_and_usage
WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
  AND line_item_line_item_type IN ('Usage', 'SavingsPlanCoveredUsage')
  AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR product_product_name = '$service')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: Percentage of eligible on-demand usage covered by Savings Plans. Higher coverage means more savings. Action: If coverage is low or 0%, evaluate purchasing Savings Plans for consistently used services like EC2 or Fargate.
panels.title: Savings Plan Coverage

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN line_item_line_item_type IN ('Usage', 'SavingsPlanCoveredUsage') THEN line_item_unblended_cost ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'SavingsPlanCoveredUsage' THEN line_item_unblended_cost ELSE 0 END)
      / SUM(CASE WHEN line_item_line_item_type IN ('Usage', 'SavingsPlanCoveredUsage') THEN line_item_unblended_cost ELSE 0 END)
  END AS coverage_pct
FROM cost_and_usage
WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
  AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR product_product_name = '$service')

panels.description: Total monthly spend over the last 6 billing periods. Shows the cost trajectory at a glance. Action: If the trend is consistently rising, investigate which services or accounts are driving the increase.
panels.title: Rolling 6-Month Spend

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT date_parse(billing_period || '-01', '%Y-%m-%d') AS month,
  SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost
FROM cost_and_usage
WHERE line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
  AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR product_product_name = '$service')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC
LIMIT 6

panels.description: Day-by-day cost breakdown. Spikes may indicate runaway resources or unexpected usage patterns. Action: Cross-reference spikes with deployment events or infrastructure changes. Yellow threshold at $50/day, red at $100/day.
panels.title: Daily Spend Trend

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT date_parse(
    split_part(identity_time_interval, '/', 1),
    '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ'
  ) AS day,
  SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost
FROM cost_and_usage
WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
  AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
  AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR product_product_name = '$service')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Daily cost stacked by the top 10 AWS services. Identifies which services drive daily cost fluctuations. Action: If a single service dominates, filter by that service to see usage types in the Top Services Detail table.
panels.title: Daily Spend by Service

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT date_parse(
    split_part(identity_time_interval, '/', 1),
    '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ'
  ) AS day,
  product_product_name AS service,
  SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost
FROM cost_and_usage
WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
  AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
  AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
  AND product_product_name IN (
    SELECT product_product_name
    FROM cost_and_usage
    WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
      AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
      AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
    GROUP BY 1
    ORDER BY SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) DESC
    LIMIT 10
  )
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Daily cost stacked by AWS account. Shows which accounts drive daily spend. Action: If one account shows a sudden spike, filter by that account to identify the responsible service.
panels.title: Daily Spend by Account

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT date_parse(
    split_part(identity_time_interval, '/', 1),
    '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ'
  ) AS day,
  line_item_usage_account_id AS account,
  SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost
FROM cost_and_usage
WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
  AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
  AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR product_product_name = '$service')
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Top 15 AWS services by cost for the selected billing period. Action: Compare with previous months using the Month-over-Month panel to identify unexpected growth in specific services.
panels.title: Spend by Service

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT product_product_name AS service,
  SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost
FROM cost_and_usage
WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
  AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
  AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR product_product_name = '$service')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.description: Cost breakdown by the Service tag applied to resources (nhp-server, nhp-ac, qurl, shared). Untagged resources appear as 'untagged'. Action: If a large portion is untagged, improve resource tagging for better cost attribution.
panels.title: Spend by Service Tag

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT COALESCE(resource_tags['user_service'], 'untagged') AS service,
  SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost
FROM cost_and_usage
WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
  AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
  AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR product_product_name = '$service')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: Cost distribution across AWS regions. Regionless services (e.g., Route 53, CloudFront) appear as 'global'. Action: If unexpected regions appear, investigate resources provisioned outside your primary region.
panels.title: Spend by Region

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(product_region, ''), 'global') AS region,
  SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost
FROM cost_and_usage
WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
  AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
  AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR product_product_name = '$service')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: Cost breakdown by the Environment tag. Untagged resources appear as 'untagged'. Action: If a significant portion is untagged, apply Environment tags to improve cost attribution across sandbox, production, and management accounts.
panels.title: Spend by Environment Tag

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT COALESCE(resource_tags['user_environment'], 'untagged') AS environment,
  SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost
FROM cost_and_usage
WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
  AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
  AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR product_product_name = '$service')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: Breakdown of costs by line item type (Usage, Tax, SavingsPlanCoveredUsage, SavingsPlanNegation, etc.). Action: Helps understand the composition of your bill and the impact of Savings Plans, credits, and discounts.
panels.title: Cost by Line Item Type

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT line_item_line_item_type AS line_item_type,
  SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost
FROM cost_and_usage
WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
  AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR product_product_name = '$service')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: Services with the largest absolute dollar change compared to the prior billing period. Shows which services are driving cost increases or decreases. Action: Investigate services with large positive changes for unexpected growth.
panels.title: Top Cost Movers

targets.rawSQL:
WITH current_period AS (
  SELECT product_product_name AS service,
    SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost
  FROM cost_and_usage
  WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
    AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
    AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
  GROUP BY 1
),
prior_bp AS (
  SELECT MAX(billing_period) AS bp
  FROM cost_and_usage
  WHERE billing_period < '$billing_period'
),
prior_period AS (
  SELECT product_product_name AS service,
    SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost
  FROM cost_and_usage
  WHERE billing_period = (SELECT bp FROM prior_bp)
    AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
    AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(c.service, p.service) AS service,
  COALESCE(c.cost, 0) AS current_cost,
  COALESCE(p.cost, 0) AS prior_cost,
  COALESCE(c.cost, 0) - COALESCE(p.cost, 0) AS change,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.cost, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE 100.0 * (COALESCE(c.cost, 0) - COALESCE(p.cost, 0)) / p.cost
  END AS pct_change
FROM current_period c
FULL OUTER JOIN prior_period p ON c.service = p.service
ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(c.cost, 0) - COALESCE(p.cost, 0)) DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.description: Costs for always-on infrastructure that bills continuously regardless of traffic: NAT Gateways, load balancers, EBS volumes, Elastic IPs, KMS keys, and VPC endpoints. This is the floor of your AWS bill. Action: Review whether all always-on resources are still needed.
panels.title: Always-On Infrastructure Costs

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT product_product_name AS service,
  line_item_usage_type AS usage_type,
  SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost,
  SUM(line_item_usage_amount) AS usage_amount,
  pricing_unit
FROM cost_and_usage
WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
  AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
  AND (
    line_item_usage_type LIKE '%NatGateway%'
    OR line_item_usage_type LIKE '%IdleAddress%'
    OR line_item_usage_type LIKE '%ElasticIP%'
    OR line_item_usage_type LIKE '%EBS:VolumeUsage%'
    OR line_item_usage_type LIKE '%EBS:SnapshotUsage%'
    OR line_item_usage_type LIKE '%LoadBalancerUsage%'
    OR line_item_usage_type LIKE '%KMS%'
    OR line_item_usage_type LIKE '%VpcEndpoint%'
    OR line_item_usage_type LIKE '%Endpoint-Hour%'
  )
  AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 5
HAVING SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) > 0
ORDER BY 3 DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.description: Detailed cost breakdown by service, usage type, and pricing unit. Shows the top 50 line items. Action: Use this to identify specific usage types driving cost for a given service, such as data transfer or provisioned capacity.
panels.title: Top Services Detail

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT product_product_name AS service,
  line_item_usage_type AS usage_type,
  SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost,
  SUM(line_item_usage_amount) AS usage_amount,
  pricing_unit
FROM cost_and_usage
WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
  AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
  AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR product_product_name = '$service')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 5
ORDER BY 3 DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.description: Data transfer costs broken down by service and usage type. Helps identify cross-region, cross-AZ, and internet egress transfer costs. Action: If transfer costs are high, consider VPC endpoints, CloudFront, or co-locating resources.
panels.title: Data Transfer Costs

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT product_product_name AS service,
  line_item_usage_type AS usage_type,
  SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost,
  SUM(line_item_usage_amount) AS usage_amount
FROM cost_and_usage
WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
  AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
  AND line_item_usage_type LIKE '%DataTransfer%'
  AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR product_product_name = '$service')
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) > 0
ORDER BY 3 DESC
LIMIT 30

panels.description: EC2 costs broken down by instance type. Helps identify rightsizing opportunities and the most expensive instance families. Note: This panel always shows EC2 costs regardless of the Service filter. Action: If large instance types dominate, evaluate downsizing or switching to Graviton (ARM) instances.
panels.title: EC2 Instance Type Costs

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(product_instance_type, ''), 'other') AS instance_type,
  line_item_usage_type AS usage_type,
  SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost,
  SUM(line_item_usage_amount) AS usage_hours
FROM cost_and_usage
WHERE billing_period = '$billing_period'
  AND line_item_line_item_type != 'Tax'
  AND line_item_product_code = 'AmazonEC2'
  AND ('$account' = 'All' OR line_item_usage_account_id = '$account')
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) > 0
ORDER BY 3 DESC
LIMIT 30
